@datars/std/annotate.doc: A callout: text offset from a point (in plot coordinates via scales, or px), with a connector and a dot.

pin.doc: Pinned at the point: dot, connector and text keep screen size under cameras (map callouts).

@datars/std/area.doc: Filled areas from a baseline (0, or `y0`) to y — one per series. For stacked areas, give a stacked table (op.stack) and y0/y fields.

@datars/std/attribution.doc: The data credit a map owes (OpenStreetMap's licence requires it), in the bottom-right corner of its box, legible and linked to the licence page (hosts make it a real link; SVG/PDF keep it). Place it outside the map's view so it stays put while the camera moves.

link.doc: Where the credit links (OpenStreetMap's copyright page, as its guidelines ask).

@datars/std/axis.doc: An axis for a scale: tick labels, tick marks and a domain line. Labels never pile up: a horizontal numeric axis asks for as many ticks as its measured labels fit; category names wrap in their band, turn 45° when a word is wider than the band, and leave out every k-th name only when even that doesn't fit.

data.doc: The table a band scale's categories come from (with `field`): their names are measured, so a horizontal axis wraps, turns or leaves out labels only as they need.

ticks.doc: Tick count hint (0 = automatic: from the axis length, and across, from how many of its measured labels fit).

type.doc: The scale's type (`linear`, `log`, `time`, …; the plot passes it). A horizontal numeric axis fits its tick count to its labels' measured width.

@datars/std/bar.doc: Bars from a category field on a band scale to a value on a linear scale (vertical or horizontal, decided by which axis is the band). Negative values hang below zero.

chapter.doc: Clicking a bar enters this program chapter with the bar's category (drill-down).

fill.doc: Fill ink or expression (default: the colour scale, else $mark).

label.doc: Bar label (tooltip, accessible name): an expression over the row; default `name: value`.

labels.doc: Value labels on the bars (they count when values change).

selected.doc: A keyset signal: selected bars stay strong, others recede.

@datars/std/basemap.doc: A basemap from a vector-tile source (our own OSM / Natural Earth archives): sea, land, water, parks, buildings, roads by class, borders and place labels, in the enclosing map's projection, styled by the theme's map tokens. Put it first inside a view with a `geo` coordinate system; data layers go after it (or between `part: base` and `part: labels`).

layers.doc: Archive layer names, if they differ from the defaults: { land, water, lakes, parks, rivers, buildings, roads, boundaries, places }.

part.doc: Split the map around data layers: `base` below them, `labels` above.

sea.doc: Fill the world behind the land with $map.water.

tileSize.doc: On-screen tile size the zoom aims for (px). Smaller: more detail, more tiles.

@datars/std/bollinger.doc: Bollinger bands: the moving average of `y` over `window` rows with a shaded band `k` standard deviations (population σ) above and below it — where the price is stretched, and how volatile it is. Computes over `source` when given, like `movingAverage`; the plot fits its value axis to the band.

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

source.doc: A longer history to compute over (see movingAverage).

stroke.doc: Ink of the band's edges and middle line.

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

@datars/std/calendar.doc: A calendar heatmap: a week-column × weekday-row grid per year, coloured by value.

cell.doc: Cell size in px (0 = fit the width).

date.doc: A date (or day-of-year with a year field).

label.doc: Day label (tooltip, accessible name); default `date: value`.

@datars/std/candlestick.doc: Candlesticks: per row a wick from low to high and a body from open to close, in `$up` when the close is at or above the open and `$down` below. Use in a plot with `xType: "band"` over dates for trading days without gaps; the plot fits its value axis to the lows and highs. Hovering a candle reads its date, OHLC and change.

close.doc: Closing price field (default: the plot's `y`, else `close`).

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

hollow.doc: Hollow candles: rising bodies outlined, falling ones filled.

label.doc: Candle label (tooltip, accessible name); default date · O H L C (change).

width.doc: Body width: a fraction of the band on a band scale (0 = the band, whose padding leaves the gaps), px on a continuous scale (0 = 70% of the spacing).

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

y.doc: The plot's value field: the close, unless `close` is given.

@datars/std/card.doc: A text card over the chart: an optional kicker and title over wrapped body text, on the theme's card surface, anchored to a corner or edge of its box. Drawn by the engine (so it's in video, PNG and PDF too); empty text hides it, and a card whose text changes between states morphs.

at.doc: Where the card sits in its box — or an expression over signals, for a card that moves between states. With `dodge`, `auto` (and any anchor, as a first choice) moves it to where it covers the least data and text.

dodge.doc: Move out of the way of data and text (taking a band below the chart when nowhere is free). Off: the card stays at `at` (`auto`: top-right), over whatever is there — a card over a map, where land covers everything.

kicker.doc: A small accent line above the title (empty: no line).

margin.doc: Space between the card and its box's edges (px, or [top, right, bottom, left]).

text.doc: The body text (a string, or an expression over signals: one card narrating every state).

title.doc: A bold line above the text (empty: no line).

@datars/std/cell.doc: Heatmap cells: a rectangle per (x, y) on two band scales, coloured by the colour scale. Keys (x, y) match grouped bars, so the two morph.

color.doc: The value field (on a sequential/diverging colour scale).

label.doc: Cell label (tooltip, accessible name); default `y, x: value`.

@datars/std/cloud.doc: A point cloud of any size (millions of rows): dots at their own x/y in an explorable view — a density-preserving sample at every zoom, every row up close, a tooltip on each.

bbox.doc: The extent to frame, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the rows' units. Default: the rows' extent — give it for millions of rows (finding it reads them all) and for point archives.

budget.doc: Rows per tile of the index at average density (smaller: lighter tiles, more of them).

children.doc: Drawn over the dots, in the same coordinates (annotations, marks).

data.doc: A table, or a point archive (a `tiles` source the publish compiler wrote).

explore.doc: The signals the camera explores with (`<explore>.x`, `.y`, `.zoom`).

fill.doc: Dot ink, or an expression over the row (default $mark).

glow.doc: Radius (px) of a glow under the dots (a number or an expression over the row): a sample drawn large and faint, so density reads at a glance and, up close, stars bloom. None by default.

glowOpacity.doc: The glow's opacity per dot: a number (default 0.05) or an expression over the row (weight bright rows).

glowPoints.doc: How many dots the glow draws at most.

label.doc: Tooltip and accessible name per row (default `x, y`).

maxZoom.doc: How far in the reader can zoom, × the whole.

name.doc: What the rows are, for the accessible description ('4,000,000 stars').

opacity.doc: Per-dot opacity: an expression over the row.

points.doc: The most dots a frame draws: a view holding more shows a uniform sample this size, one holding fewer shows every row.

r.doc: Dot radius in screen px: a number, or an expression over the row.

@datars/std/dot.doc: A dot per category at its value (a dot plot).

@datars/std/dotDensity.doc: Dot density: one dot per `per` units of a region's value, scattered evenly inside it (seeded, deterministic).

@datars/std/drawdown.doc: Drawdown: how far each series sits below its running peak (0 at a new high, −25 % a quarter below it), as an area hanging from zero — the pain chart next to a performance chart. With `source`, peaks count from the start of the whole history instead of the first visible row. Use with `format: ".0%"` on the plot.

area.doc: Shade from zero (one series; several draw lines only).

color.doc: The plot's colour field (line and label inks).

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

format.doc: Format of the drawdown in end labels.

labels.doc: Label each series' end with its name and current drawdown (with a series; pushed apart).

series.doc: One drawdown per series (default: the colour field).

source.doc: A longer history: peaks before the rows on show count too.

stroke.doc: Line ink (default: $down, or the colour scale per series).

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

@datars/std/facet.doc: Small multiples: the given chart once per value of `by`, in a grid; inside, the chart's `data` is that group's rows ("@group"), on scales shared across panels unless `shared: false`.

chart.doc: A chart (e.g. plot(...)) to repeat; its data is replaced by each group.

shared.doc: Every panel on the same x and y scales (the whole table's extent), so panels compare at a glance; off: each fits its own rows.

@datars/std/funnel.doc: A funnel: stage names in a measured column, centred bars in stage order joined by tapering connectors, each labelled with the conversion from the stage before.

conversion.doc: Connectors between stages, labelled with the share that carries on (↓ 44 %).

fill.doc: The bars' colour (default $mark); labels inside take whichever of ink and paper reads on it.

@datars/std/geoLines.doc: Line features of a geo source (roads, borders, courses, routes) as non-scaling strokes. With `data` and `key`, one line per row (the feature with that id) — data, not decoration — coloured by `value` on piecewise `stops`.

key.doc: The data field holding each row's feature id.

@datars/std/geoPoints.doc: Points at lon/lat (cities, events, stations), in the enclosing map's projection, in $map.marker ringed by $map.label-halo so they read on any land.

@datars/std/grid.doc: Gridlines at a scale's ticks across the plot area.

count.doc: A tick count as an expression — the axis's own (a plot passes it), so every gridline meets a tick.

@datars/std/grouped.doc: Grouped (dodged) bars: a group per x, a bar per series side by side. Keys (series, x), shared with stacked segments and heatmap cells, so the three morph.

format.doc: Number format of each bar's label.

gap.doc: Padding between bars of a group (band fraction).

labels.doc: Value labels on the bars (they count when values change), where they fit a bar's width.

prefix.doc: Before each bar's number in its label ('$').

series.doc: The series within each group (default: the colour field).

@datars/std/hemicycle.doc: A parliament: one dot per seat on concentric arcs, grouped by party left to right. Seats are keyed (party, Unit i).

align.doc: In a box taller than it needs (a phone): centred up and down, or at the bottom (with a line of text right under it).

@datars/std/indexed.doc: Series rebased to their first visible row — 100 (or 0 %) — so instruments at any price compare as performance: one line per series with a baseline, each labelled at its end with its change. Filter the rows to a range and every line starts from the base again. Use with `format: "+.0%"` on the plot for `percent`.

base.doc: The value every series starts at.

color.doc: The plot's colour field (line and label inks).

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

format.doc: Format of the change in end labels.

labels.doc: Label each line's end: series and change (pushed apart so they never overlap).

percent.doc: Change from the start (0 = no change, 0.1 = +10 %) instead of an index.

series.doc: One line per series (default: the colour field).

stroke.doc: Line ink (default: the colour scale, else $mark).

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

@datars/std/legend.doc: A legend for a colour scale: a swatch and a label per entry, flowing in rows (spaced by the labels' widths, wrapping at the box edge).

@datars/std/line.doc: One line per series (the colour field, or `series`), through x/y. Draws on as it enters.

clip.doc: Clip the lines to the plot area (the end labels stay outside it).

labels.doc: Label each line at its last point (labels pushed apart so they never overlap).

selected.doc: A keyset signal: selected series stay strong, the others recede.

series.doc: Group rows into lines by this field (default: the colour field).

yScale.doc: The value scale: `y2` for a plot's right axis.

@datars/std/map.doc: A map: regions of a geo source, coloured by a data table joined on a key (choropleth), with neutral backdrop land, over which children (symbols, points, lines, annotations) draw in the same projection.

backdrop.doc: Draw regions without data too (in $map.no-data); off: only regions with data.

base.doc: Layers beneath everything, moving with the camera: a basemap (`basemap({ part: 'base' })`).

camera.doc: A camera over the map: {fit: {keys: [...]} | {bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1]}, padding} — bbox corners may be expressions like geo.x(lon, lat). Cameras fly between states; the projection stays.

chapter.doc: Clicking a region enters this program chapter with the region's id (drill-down).

children.doc: Layers drawn on top: symbols, geoPoints, geoLines, annotations.

fillOpacity.doc: Region opacity; default 0.85 over a `base` basemap (its streets and water show through), else 1.

fit.doc: What the projection fits: {keys: [...]}, {bbox: [lon0, lat0, lon1, lat1]} or the whole source (default). A fit clips the map to its box.

key.doc: The data column holding region ids.

label.doc: Region label (tooltip, accessible name): an expression over the region row; default `name: value`.

legend.doc: A colour ramp (or swatches, for categorical colour) in the lower-left corner.

projection.doc: equal-earth, mercator, web-mercator, natural-earth, albers-usa, orthographic, sweref99tm, planar, …

regions.doc: Draw the source's regions; off: only the layers (a camera beat over a basemap).

sea.doc: Fill the map's box with $map.water first (the sea around atlas regions, in themes that colour it).

selected.doc: A keyset signal: selected regions stay strong, the others recede.

source.doc: A geo source (GeoJSON, TopoJSON or an atlas like `countries`).

under.doc: Another geo source drawn beneath as neutral land (countries around admin-1 regions).

@datars/std/movingAverage.doc: A moving average of the plot's `y` (a closing price) as a line: simple (the mean of the last `window` rows) or exponential (span `window`). Computed over `source` — the whole history — when given, so the first day on show already has its full window. Shown in the plot's indicator key.

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

full.doc: Only full windows: no line until `window` rows (else the first rows average what there is).

label.doc: Name in the indicator key and to screen readers (default `SMA 20`).

source.doc: A longer history of the same rows to compute over (the chart shows only the rows of `data`).

stroke.doc: Line ink (default: $accent, or the colour scale per series).

window.doc: Rows per window (trading days on a band scale): 20 ≈ a month, 50, 200.

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

@datars/std/ohlc.doc: OHLC bars: per row a vertical line from low to high with the open ticked to the left and the close to the right, in `$up`/`$down` by direction (or ink). Same fields and plot fitting as `candlestick`.

close.doc: Closing price field (default: the plot's `y`, else `close`).

colored.doc: Colour by direction; off: every bar in `$ink`.

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

label.doc: Bar label; default date · O H L C (change).

width.doc: Tick span: a fraction of the band (0 = the band), px on a continuous scale.

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

y.doc: The plot's value field: the close, unless `close` is given.

@datars/std/pareto.doc: The running share of the total, from the largest category down, as a line with points on the plot's right axis (`right: { domain: [0, 1], format: '.0%' }`) — over bars sorted descending, a Pareto chart.

stroke.doc: Line ink (default: the theme's secondary mark).

@datars/std/pie.doc: Parts of a whole as slices (set `inner` > 0 for a donut). Colours from the categorical palette by category.

inner.doc: Inner radius as a fraction of the outer (0 = pie, 0.6 = donut).

total.doc: Show the total in the middle (donuts).

@datars/std/plot.doc: A cartesian frame: x/y (and colour) scales from data, axes and gridlines sized by the engine, a title, and marks as children.

brush.doc: A signal to brush into: dragging across the plot selects a range of the category/time axis (see `brush()` and `brushed()`).

clip.doc: Clip marks to the plot area (for explicit domains narrower than the data: a zoom).

color.doc: Field mapped to colour (categorical by default).

data.doc: The table marks read by default.

labelSpace.doc: Room at the right (px) when a line child labels its ends.

legend.doc: A colour legend below the plot.

lower.doc: A pane under the plot area on the same x with its own value axis, scale `lower`: {y, data?, height? (fraction or px, 0.22), format?, label?}. Marks go there with `yScale: "lower"`; a `volume` child makes one when it isn't given.

nice.doc: Round linear domains to nice numbers.

right.doc: A second value axis on the right, scale `y2`: {y, data?, domain?, label?, format?, prefix?, suffix?}. Marks use it with `yScale: "y2"`.

xFormat.doc: Number format for the x axis's labels, whichever axis holds the values: 'd' reads decimal years on a linear axis as whole years (a whole-number format labels whole-number ticks only).

xTicks.doc: Tick count hint for the x axis (0 = from its length).

yFormat.doc: Number format for the y axis's labels (overrides `format` there).

yTicks.doc: Tick count hint for the y axis (0 = from its length).

zero.doc: Include zero in the value axis's domain (default: yes; prices under candles, averages, bands and indexed lines fit their range instead).

@datars/std/point.doc: A dot per row (instanced: scales to 10⁵–10⁶ points).

@datars/std/route.doc: Great-circle routes between two lon/lat points per row.

@datars/std/rule.doc: A reference line at a value on the x or y scale (a target, an average, 'today').

@datars/std/sankey.doc: Flows between nodes: nodes in columns by depth, ribbons as wide as their flow. Links keep their row key (bars of the same rows morph into ribbons).

label.doc: Link label (tooltip, accessible name); default `source → target: value`.

selected.doc: A keyset signal of node names: links touching them stay strong, the others recede.

@datars/std/slider.doc: A slider for a numeric signal: press or drag to set it (snapped to `step`). Shows the label and the current value.

@datars/std/span.doc: A shaded band between two values on the x or y scale (a recession, a target range).

@datars/std/sparkline.doc: A sparkline: a word-sized line of `y` over `x` that fills its box (a table cell, a card) — no axes, the last value marked with a dot, coloured `$up` or `$down` by whether it ended above where it started. Works on any table, `@group` too (one per ticker in a repeat).

data.doc: The rows (a named table, or `@group` inside a repeat).

dot.doc: A dot at the last value.

fill.doc: A soft area under the line.

name.doc: What the line is (its accessible label starts with it).

trend.doc: Colour by the change over the line ($up / $down); off: $mark.

xType.doc: x scale: `point` spaces rows evenly (trading days), `time` by date.

@datars/std/stacked.doc: Stacked bars: a segment per series in each category (offset `expand` for 100 %); horizontal when y is the band axis. Keys (series, x), shared with grouped bars and heatmap cells.

format.doc: Number format of each segment's label (its value label, hover, screen readers).

labels.doc: Value labels inside the segments (they count when values change), where they fit.

segmentKey.doc: Segment key (default the composite `(series, category)`, so segments merge into their series' bar); e.g. `d.party` so one 100 % bar's segments pair with that party's bar or slice.

@datars/std/stripes.doc: Colour stripes: one full-height band per ordered value, on a diverging scale around `mid`.

label.doc: Stripe label (tooltip, accessible name); default `x: value`.

@datars/std/swarm.doc: A beeswarm: every row a dot along one value axis, packed so none overlap (windowed neighbour search; 20k dots in about a second).

@datars/std/symbols.doc: Proportional symbols: a circle per region (or point feature) at its visual centre, area ∝ value — or all one size (`r`) without a value field.

label.doc: Label per symbol (tooltip, accessible name); default `name: value`.

stops.doc: Colour by value on piecewise stops ('#bae6fd 7 · #0b1f3a 14.2') instead of one fill.

value.doc: Size by this field (omit for same-size dots).

@datars/std/title.doc: A title (and optional subtitle and source line).

@datars/std/track.doc: A path over time (a storm, a flight): drawn up to `until` (a data-time signal) with a moving head.

future.doc: Draw the whole path faintly underneath (where it will go).

until.doc: Data time to draw up to (e.g. the `year` signal).

@datars/std/treemap.doc: A squarified treemap: area ∝ value, one rectangle per category, labels where they fit. Coloured by category, or by a value on piecewise stops.

color.doc: Colour by this field (default: the category).

@datars/std/volume.doc: Volume bars under a price chart: in a plot, they go to a pane below the price area that shares its x axis and has its own value axis (the plot's `lower` pane, made for them when not given), coloured like their day's candle.

close.doc: Closing price field (default: the plot's `y`, else `close`).

colored.doc: Colour by the day's direction; off: `$muted`.

data.doc: The rows to draw (default: the plot's).

width.doc: Bar width: a fraction of the band (0 = the band), px on a continuous scale.

xType.doc: `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value.

y.doc: The plot's value field: the close, unless `close` is given.

yScale.doc: The value scale: `lower` (the plot's lower pane), or `y` for a volume chart of its own.

@datars/std/waffle.doc: One square per unit (e.g. per percentage point). Units are keyed (category, Unit i), so bars split into squares and back.

@datars/std/waterfall.doc: A waterfall/bridge: each change floats from the running total; rows marked as totals (a boolean field, or keys starting with '=') are bars from zero.
